_about: Shared settings for the globe page. city picks the folder in data/ that opens by default; a link ending in ?city=<folder> opens another one. cities lists the folders offered in the page's City chooser, which appears once two are listed. Each city's title, focus and baselines live in data/<city>/city.json. Baselines download only when zoomed in past load_from_zoom, and only the years in use; max_loaded caps how many stay in memory.
